method: pysheds 0.5 fill_pits, fill_depressions, resolve_flats, D8 (dirmap 64,128,1,2,4,8,16,32) on the native 1 arc-second window [-6.7, 31.4, -6.001, 31.85]; outlet snapped as frozen; cells inside the delineated catchment with at least 1.0 km2 upstream (accumulation weighted by geodesic cell area); Strahler order; reaches from cell centres, one Chaikin pass, Douglas-Peucker 8 m, densified to 15 m; heights bilinear from the 30 m relief grid at every vertex

checks.note: lines follow the drawn 30 m relief surface; where it does not resolve a channel floor the line rises with the surface instead of cutting under it
